title: Parliamentarians Dawa Tsering and Dawa Tsering Bari to Visit South India
author: Dawa Tsering
content:
Dharamshala: As part of the official program of the 18th Tibetan Parliament-in-Exile, Parliamentarians Dawa Tsering and Dawa Tsering Bari are scheduled to visit Dikyi Larsoe Settlement, Bylakuppe in South India, and areas under the jurisdiction of the Chief Representative Office of South Zone in Bangalore from 5 to 13 August 2026.

On 5 August, the parliamentarians will depart from Dharamshala to Delhi and travel to Bangalore on the next day. From 6-7 August, they will have engagements in Bangalore, and leave for Bylakuppe on 9 August, and have program there until 13 August.

– Filed by Tibetan Parliamentary Secretariat
